description_en: Searches for agent outbound call records by criteria
description_zh: 根据条件查询座席外呼通话记录
kebab_example: aliyun dyvmsapi cloud-query-ob-cdr --enterprise-id 7000002 --unique-id uniq_1-162046xxxx.12 --request-unique-id req_uniq_1-162046xxxx.12 --call-type 4 --status 33 --province '北京' --city '北京' --time-range-type 1 --start-time 1775024775 --end-time 1775030413 --start 0 --limit 10 --user-fieldkey userFieldkey_:_userFieldvalue --user-field-value userFieldkey_:_userFieldvalue --customer-number 13322223333 --cno 1111 --gno 455 --agent-number 41008502 --agent-name name3 --clid 4100 --left-display-number 2000 --order 0 --return-count 1 --down-grade 0 --is-real-answer 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CloudQueryObCdr

parameters.help_en: The call center ID
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫中心 id
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the call. If you specify this parameter, the API ignores all other parameters and returns only the record with the matching unique ID
parameters.help_zh: 如果uniqueId值不为空，则以下其它参数无效，即仅查询电话唯一标识为uniqueId的记录信息
parameters.name: unique_id

parameters.help_en: The request unique ID. The system queries the current month by default. If the record for the specified `RequestUniqueId` is not in the current month, you must also specify the `StartTime` parameter
parameters.help_zh: 查询请求唯一id对应的记录信息，默认查询当前月，如requestUniqueId不属于当前月，查询时请传递查询参数 查询开始时间(startTime)
parameters.name: request_unique_id

parameters.help_en: The call type. If omitted, all call types are returned. Valid values: `4` (Preview outbound call), `6` (Caller-initiated outbound call), and `9` (Internal call)
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫类型；为空表示全部，可选值为：4:预览外呼 6:主叫外呼 9:内部呼叫
parameters.name: call_type

parameters.help_en: The call result. Valid values: `30` (Agent did not answer), `31` (Agent answered, customer not dialed), `32` (Agent answered, customer did not answer), `33` (Both agent and customer answered), `50` (Caller-initiated outbound call: customer answered), `51` (Caller-initiated outbound call: customer did not answer), `52` (Caller-initiated outbound call: both parties answered)
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫结果；参数说明：30 座席未接听; 31 座席接听,未呼叫客户; 32 座席接听,客户未接听; 33 双方接听; 50 主叫外呼接听; 51 主叫外呼,客户未接听; 52 主叫外呼,双方接听
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The province where the customer's phone number is registered. If omitted, records from all provinces are returned. Example: `Sichuan`. This value must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 客户电话归属省份；为空表示全部，如"四川"，此参数需要URLEncode
parameters.name: province

parameters.help_en: The city where the customer's phone number is registered. If omitted, records from all cities are returned. Example: `Chengdu`. This value must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 客户电话归属城市；为空表示全部，如"成都"，此参数需要URLEncode
parameters.name: city

parameters.help_en: Specifies which timestamp the `StartTime` and `EndTime` parameters apply to. This parameter applies only when you specify both `StartTime` and `EndTime`. Valid values: `1` (start time) and `2` (end time). Default: `1`
parameters.help_zh: 查询时间开始结束范围生效类型；通话记录startTime和endTime时间范围生效类型，当startTime和endTime不为空时生效；取值：1.呼叫开始时间 2.呼叫结束时间； 默认为1
parameters.name: time_range_type

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query time range, specified as a Unix timestamp in seconds. The `StartTime` and `EndTime` must be within the same calendar month. Default: The first day of the current month
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间；时间戳格式,精确到s。startTime与endTime不允许跨月，默认值取当前月份第一天
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query time range, specified as a Unix timestamp in seconds. The `StartTime` and `EndTime` must be within the same calendar month. Default: The last day of the current month
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间；时间戳格式,精确到s。startTime与endTime不允许跨月，默认值取当前月份最后一天
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The zero-based index of the first record to return. Default: `0`
parameters.help_zh: 从第几条开始取；大于等于0，默认0
parameters.name: start

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records to return per page. The value must be in the range of 1 to 1,000. Default: `10`
parameters.help_zh: 需要取出的数据条数；大于0，最大不能超过1000，默认10
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The key of a user-defined field. Use this parameter with `UserFieldValue` to filter results by a specific user-defined field. Fuzzy matching is not supported. This value must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义参数指定查询key；传递该参数时必须传递userFieldValue，仅查询一个字段，不支持模糊匹配，构造的自定义字段查询条件为:{"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}，此参数需要URLEncode
parameters.name: user_fieldkey

parameters.help_en: The value of a user-defined field. Use this parameter with `UserFieldkey` to filter results by a specific user-defined field. Fuzzy matching is not supported. This value must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义参数指定查询value；传递该参数时必须传递userFieldKey，仅查询一个字段，不支持模糊匹配，构造的自定义字段查询条件为:{"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}，此参数需要URLEncode
parameters.name: user_field_value

parameters.help_en: The customer number. To query multiple numbers, provide a comma-separated list of up to 100 numbers. Fuzzy matching is not supported
parameters.help_zh: 客户号码，支持一个或多个客户号码查询，多个客户号码以英文逗号隔开，一次最多支持100个。不支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: customer_number

parameters.help_en: The agent ID. Each ID must be 3 to 10 characters long. To query multiple IDs, provide a comma-separated list of up to 100 IDs. Fuzzy matching is not supported
parameters.help_zh: 座席工号，单个座席工号3-10位，支持一个或多个座席工号查询，多个座席工号以英文逗号隔开，一次最多支持100个。不支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: cno

parameters.help_en: The agent's outbound group ID. The ID must be 2 to 20 characters long. To query multiple IDs, provide a comma-separated list of up to 10 IDs. Fuzzy matching is not supported
parameters.help_zh: 座席所属外呼组 单个外呼组号2-20位，支持一个或多个座席工号查询，多个座席工号以英文逗号隔开，一次最多支持10个。不支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: gno

parameters.help_en: The agent number
parameters.help_zh: 座席号码
parameters.name: agent_number

parameters.help_en: The agent name
parameters.help_zh: 座席姓名
parameters.name: agent_name

parameters.help_en: The Calling Line Identification (CLID) that was displayed to the customer
parameters.help_zh: 客户侧外显号码过滤条件
parameters.name: clid

parameters.help_en: The actual display number on the customer's device. For AXB outbound calls that use a virtual number, this parameter filters by the virtual number if this option is enabled
parameters.help_zh: 客户侧真实外显号码过滤条件，当使用虚拟号进行AXB外呼且开关打开时，实际过滤的客户侧真实外显号码是虚拟号
parameters.name: left_display_number

parameters.help_en: The sort order. Valid values: `0` (start time, ascending), `1` (start time, descending), `2` (end time, ascending), `3` (end time, descending)
parameters.help_zh: 排序方式；取值说明：0: 按照记录产生的时序顺序排序，1：按照记录产生的时序逆序排序，2: 按照结束时间的时序顺序排序，3：按照结束时间的时序逆序排序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return the total count of matching records. Valid values: `1` (Yes) and `0` (No). Default: `1`
parameters.help_zh: 是否返回总条数；取值说明：0: 不返回，1：返回，不传默认为1
parameters.name: return_count

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the call was a downgraded call. Valid values: `0` (No) and `1` (Yes)
parameters.help_zh: 是否呼叫降级；0-否, 1-是
parameters.name: down_grade

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the call was a live answer. Valid values: `0` (No) and `1` (Yes)
parameters.help_zh: 真人接听；取值说明：1-是、0-否
parameters.name: is_real_answer
